programme.desc: Kehidupan biasa dan sederhana Thach, Mai dan Dung terjalin tanpa disangka-sangka dalam kisah lucu dan pelik tentang peluang dan permulaan baru.

programme.title: Keabadian Cinta
programme.desc: Telefilem Keabadian Cinta arahan Khabir Bhatia memaparkan tiga kisah cinta dalam satu cerita.

programme.title: 5 Minit
programme.desc: A young father, who had his daughter out of wedlock, relives his misspent youth while waiting the infinite 5 minutes to find out whether his own teenage, unmarried daughter is now pregnant.

programme.title: Sesaat Lebih
programme.desc: Adeef goes to Taiwan to retrace cherished memories. Adelia travels in search of healing. Fate reunites them, opening a new chapter between pain and hope.

programme.title: Kembar Sado
programme.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan tentang saudara kembar yang dibesarkan dua keluarga berlainan latar belakang. Seorang begitu jujur dan ikhlas manakala seorang lagi hilang arah tujuan hidup. Ikuti cerita mereka.

programme.title: Jejak Warriors
programme.desc: Apabila Wan Raja mendapat tahu impian ayahnya tidak pernah terkabul, dia mengembara dari Johor Bahru ke Kota Bharu, berdepan dengan pelbagai rintangan untuk merealisasikan impian ayahnya.

programme.title: Walid
programme.desc: Walid kembali ke Jihad Ummah menuntut takhta, namun Ummi Hafizah melawan. Pertelingkahan tegang memicu keputusan yang mengubah takdir—apabila batas dilanggar, siapa akan bertahan di runtuhan empayar?

programme.title: Walid
programme.desc: Selepas rampasan kuasa, tatanan baharu terbentuk di Jihad Ummah. Habiburrahman mendakwa ketuhanan, memukau pengikut—namun janji penyelamatan menyembunyikan realiti yang lebih gelap.

programme.title: The Making of Polong
programme.desc: Maria Hadi bertaubat dari ilmu hitam sebelum mati. Tersilap mewariskan polong, makhluk itu membalas dendam dan menyumpah pewarisnya.

programme.title: Senario The Movie Episod 2 Beach Boys
programme.desc: The Beach Boys - Azlee, Mazlan dan Wahid kembali untuk menyempurnakan misi mereka menyelamatkan sebuah resort yang hampir ditutup.

programme.title: Adiwira Ku
programme.desc: Berdasarkan dari kisah benar mengenai pasukan 'choral speaking' SMK Pinang Tunggal di Kedah yang mengharungi pelbagai kepayahan dan cabaran demi untuk memenangi pertandingan tersebut.

programme.title: Seandainya Kau Ada
programme.desc: Pasangan kekasih berpisah tatkala lelaki yang dikasihi pergi melanjutkan pelajaran. Dia berjanji akan mengahwini pasangannya bila dia kembali. Tetapi terhalang setelah dia temui perenpuan lain.

programme.title: Anakku Sazali
programme.desc: Kasih sayang akan menjadi racun hidup yang paling berbisa bila diberi secara berlebih-lebihan. Lakonan Allahyarham Tan Sri P.Ramlee dan Allahyarham Nordin Ahmad.

programme.title: Sultan Mahmood Mangkat Dijulang
programme.desc: Seorang pembesar istana tidak berpuas hati dengan perkahwinan Dang Anum sanggup melakukan fitnah hingga Dang Anum mati dibunuh Sultan.

programme.title: Good Boys Go To Heaven
programme.desc: The retelling of Good Boys Go to Heaven, recounting the chronology of Ahyan's murder.

programme.title: Gerak Khas The Movie 3
programme.desc: Unit Gerak Khas cuba menyelesaikan kes pembunuhan Suzana dan Inspektor Aleza, Haris dan Farah yang baru sebulan dipindahkan ke unit berkenaan ditugaskan menyiasat kes itu.

programme.title: Cupcake Mama
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Hanna, isteri dan ibu yang bosan dengan rutin hidup. Dorongan keluarga membawa dia memulakan perniagaan cupcake dari rumah, sambil mengimbangi peranan sebagai isteri, ibu dan usahawan.

programme.title: Cerai
programme.desc: Pengalaman berkurung dengan pasangan selama musim PKP memaksa dua pasangan suami isteri menilai semula perkahwinan mereka yang telah disalah ertikan selama ini.

programme.title: Good Boys Go To Heaven
programme.desc: Featuring exclusive behind-the-scenes footage and candid interviews, this episode captures the cast and crew's experiences, challenges, and reflections on bringing the series to life.

programme.desc: Apabila anak saudaranya diculik, Zali cuba untuk membantu namun dia mula mengesyaki ada sesuatu yang tidak kena mengenai kes penculikan tersebut...

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Hang Tuah yang telah hilang kerana mengembara ke masa hadapan pulang semula ke zaman asalnya untuk menyekat tindakan Hang Jebat dari menderhaka dan membunuh Sultan Melaka.

programme.title: Sesaat Lebih

programme.title: AI News Flash

programme.title: Burning Stars

programme.title: Sifu VS Vampire

programme.title: The Fierce Wife

programme.title: There Is No Escape From Fate

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended version)

programme.title: Oversteer

programme.title: Love Is The Only Answer
programme.desc: When a flash of her groom's infidelity is revealed at their wedding, Bo cancels the entire affair. However, within a year, he comes knocking on her door again.

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins
programme.desc: Winner of 8 HKFA awards & featuring an all-star cast, this film depicts an elite team guarding Dr Sun Yat Sen in Hong Kong, as he discusses plans to overthrow the Qing dynasty.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time in Hong Kong
programme.desc: Helmed by four Best Actors and set in Hong Kong in the 1970s, this exciting action film charts how the ICAC dealt with corruption within the police force in its early stages of establishment.

programme.title: Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: When a school bus driver is injured after risking his life to save a boy during an accident, the boy's father invites him to live with them. However, disturbing facts soon begin to emerge.

programme.title: The Vanished Murderer
programme.desc: In this sequel to THE BULLET VANISHES, Sean Lau plays an inspector who is lead down a rabbit hole of discovery as he investigates a prison escape.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: American Girl
programme.desc: During the SARS outbreak in 2003, a teenage girl struggle to adjust to life in Taipei after returning from LA, due to her mother's sickness & her younger sister's misdiagnoses with SARS.

programme.title: As It Burns
programme.desc: Detective Wei investigates a fatal explosion involving two women who look alike. As he delves deeper, Wei unveils a web of deceit as details from the past and present come together in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Sky on Fire
programme.desc: Directed by Ringo Lam, Daniel Wu stars as a security chief embroiled in a battle to protect a cure for deadly disease from falling into the wrong hands. Joseph Chang & Zhang Ruo Yun co-star.

programme.title: We Girls
programme.desc: Gao is in prison as she steals to buy a cochlear implant for her daughter. She befriends 3 women there and upon release, they stand together to defy fate and support each other in life's challenges.

programme.title: All Suspects
programme.desc: A policeman on leave checks into a B&B with a detective novelist, a drifter and a pianist. When the owner and receptionist turn up dead, every guest becomes both suspect and sleuth...

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: Based on the 1954 martial arts novel, this film details the tragic romance between wild swordsman Zhuo Yi-hang and rival cult assassin Lien Ni-chang, with a dark, erotic and visually stunning twist.

programme.title: Valley Of The Shadow Of Death
programme.desc: Years after his daughter's tragic death from assault, the offender resurfaces in church to ask for forgiveness. Torn between his faith and humanity, Pastor Leung faces a profound test.

programme.title: Red Line
programme.desc: A former professional racer falls into despair after causing his brother's death. He meets Dr. Hui & becomes an ambulance driver. Meanwhile, his friends uncover the truth behind his brother's accident.

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: Ching is a forensic psychiatrist who can enter a person's subconscious. As she investigates a murder-cum-suicide case, she finds herself under suspicion and comes face-to-face with a past trauma...

programme.title: The Lychee Road
programme.desc: A single lychee triggers a Tang Dynasty \"Mission Impossible\"! Junior official Li races 1,000 miles in three days to satisfy a consort's craving - an epic ride of tension, humour and biting satire!

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a visually impaired factory worker living in an island. After a hurricane cut them off from the outside world, a monster suddenly appears, turning whoever sees it into black shadows.

programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News
programme.desc: A mother in her 50s unexpectedly becomes pregnant, turning her family's quiet life upside down. As they prepare for the baby's arrival, chaos and laughter follow, teaching them love and acceptance.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Directed by comedy superstar Stephen Chow, this blockbuster depicts a mermaid sent to seduce a ruthless developer who is threatening her.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A traffic accident that resulted in a taxi driver being blinded inexplicably connects a group of unrelated people together, including blind masseurs from a massage center, a young man & a couple.

programme.title: The Dumpling Queen
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang moves to Hong Kong with her two daughters after a failed marriage. She builds a dumpling stall at Wan Chai Pier and rises to become the city's renowned \"Dumpling Queen\".

programme.title: The Locksmith

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II

programme.title: There Is No Escape From Fate

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.
